text: {"lessons":["My account value has fluctuated substantially, so I should expect volatility and avoid treating recent price moves as reliable forecasts.","Selling 20 shares of Stock C after a large gain reduced my exposure; I should make position changes deliberately and in line with my overall risk and goals.","I should not let average cost or a desire to recover losses drive trades; decide using current information, and remember that frequent checking does not create a trading advantage."]}
